creator: Nowicki, Robert; Heithaus, Michael; Thomson, Jordan; Burkholder, Derek; Gastrich, Kirk; Wirsing, Aaron
citation: Nowicki, R., Heithaus, M., Thomson, J., Burkholder, D., Gastrich, K. & Wirsing, A. (2019). Indirect legacy effects of an extreme climactic event on a marine megafaunal community. Ecological Monographs 89(2), e01365. https://doi.org/10.1002/ecm.1365. Data: Dryad https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.7sg523n (CC0).
samplingProtocol: Boat-based strip transects along permanent focal zones in the Eastern Gulf of Shark Bay, run at low speed in good conditions by two to six observers; every unique animal of the target taxa seen inside a taxon-specific sighting band was counted (band widths: dugong 0.2 km, dolphin 0.4 km, cormorant and turtle 0.06 km, sea snake 0.01 km); zones were run one to twelve times per monthly field period.
closure: occasion within period: the runs of one focal zone within a calendar month; mobile megafauna move between zones, so closure is approximate; open between months

geographicCoverage.description: Eastern Gulf of Shark Bay, Western Australia (Monkey Mia region), shallow seagrass banks and deep channels; focal-zone coordinates not deposited

coordinatesCoarsened.method: None in source: focal zones are numbered only; Dugong dugon (VU) and Caretta caretta (VU) flagged (IUCN via GBIF) but no coordinates exist to coarsen

title: Strip-transect counts of Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins on 11 permanent boat transects, Shark Bay, Western Australia, 1997-2014
abstract: Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphin counts from the Shark Bay focal-zone strip transects on the 2338 usable runs of 1997-1999 and 2008-2014; the source did not count dolphins reliably in 2002-2007.
surveyEvidenceNote: Each row of the Surface Transect Data tab is one run of a permanent transect, with zero counts recorded; the source's usability flags select the runs (usable = yes ; use.for.dol = yes) and every listed taxon is counted on every selected run. Runs of 2002-2007 (use.for.dol = no) are not surveys for dolphins and have no rows.

notShipped.*.d, *.d.old, *.rd, shg.d: densities, pre-heatwave seasonal mean densities and relative densities: derived from these counts
notShipped.*.area: band areas: transect length x a fixed band width per taxon (widths in __taxa)
notShipped.usable = no: 480 runs the source marks as not meeting minimum requirements (sighting conditions, data reliability), incl. every run of FZ 13 and 14 and 23 E-prefixed 2007 entries
notShipped.doubled entries: ID '-' at FZ 6 on 2014-04-04 (same times as 6201444, which is kept), the second 72014625 row on 2014-06-25 and the second 122006106 row (identical times and counts)
notShipped.min out, Raw Time, Total, Time E: suspension minutes, raw and net duration (over 250 usable runs have zero or negative net minutes, the raw time being 0) and end time: not reliable enough to ship as effort; transect length is the effort column
